candidate.name: Formal Immersion at Cusps for Levels 72 and 144
candidate.text: Candidate: Formal immersion of modular curves X_0(72) and X_0(144) into their Eisenstein quotients J_e(N) (which have rank 0) at cusps infinity and 0. Goal: Use Mazur's formal immersion criterion to bound the prime exponents p for which a Frey curve E_{A,B} can have residual representation rho_{E,p} congruent to a newform f at level 72 or 144, leveraging that j(E_{A,B}) cannot specialize to the cusp unless C=0.

legend.0: level 0: peripheral or unrelated to Beal signatures
legend.1: level 1: general modular method context without resolving any signature
legend.2: level 2: settles a concrete range of exponents or a new specific signature family
legend.3: level 3: settles an entire infinite signature family for all exponents
legend.4: level 4: resolves the complete conjecture outright
